variants.caption: pixelpunch 2.0 is HERE 🎉 new tilemap editor, hot reload for everything (not just shaders this time), a sound mixer that doesn't hate you, export to web in one click, and a brand new tutorial series made with @mirabyte and @tomtomdev. huge thanks to everyone who filed bugs during the beta, you made this. go break it 🐛🔥 pixelpunch.example/2
Our winter blend is back. Assam, orange peel, a little clove.

2.0 changelog 🧵

new: tilemap editor with auto-tiling, layers and collision painting

new: hot reload for scripts, shaders and assets

new: sound mixer with buses and ducking

new: one-click web export

fixed: 140 bugs you found in the beta (thank you!!)

breaking: the old input API is gone, see the migration guide at pixelpunch.example/migrate
New glaze: a deep blue that breaks to brown on the rim.
